messages:
jamie: FYI seeing ~5-10m delays in egress audit log batch to central-s3; noticed GPU node boot failures in ap-south where KMS decryption times out after 30s. Suspect the natgw/firewall rule change last night.
sam: which firewall change? any PR link?
jamie: via infra-rollouts: https://go/release/infra/PR-4829 - changed outbound SNAT rule to explicit ENI-based egress for privnet. happened 2025-11-02T03:05Z.
rita: observed similar in eu-west earlier, audit logs queued in buffer. can we get the keystore decrypt logs?
jamie: paste from node boot log:
```
2025-11-02T03:12:14Z boot: keystore: decrypt timeout error: context deadline exceeded
2025-11-02T03:12:14Z boot: trying fallback KMS endpoint us-east-1
2025-11-02T03:12:45Z boot: bootstrap failed, marking node unhealthy
```
lee: deploy-bot shows natgw config applied then conntrack spike around same time.
deploy-bot: [deploy] applied firewall/natgw PR-4829 to prod/privnet at 2025-11-02T03:05:18Z :white_check_mark:
sam: ok can we run a quick curl test from a staging pod to the KMS endpoint via privnet? also check VPC Flow Logs to see if connections were dropped.
jamie: ran curl from staging, got long TCP handshake then RST. flow logs show `REJECT` on ephemeral port range for ENI.
rita: sounds like the SNAT change tightened ephemeral port mapping; KMS calls get mapped to the new ENI and stateful firewall dropped return.
lee: mitigation: rolling back PR-4829 in prod now, will reapply with conntrack-safe rules.
jamie: after rollback node bootstrap rate improved, requeued ~60 failed boots, now 48 completed, 12 still pending.
sam: create follow-up ticket to add end-to-end test: KMS decrypt + flowlog assert + boot e2e. Also schedule a postmortem with security to review firewall hardening and audit delivery SLA.
rita: opening ticket INFRA-2345 and cc'ing compliance for audit retention impact.
lee: thanks, we'll add Traffic Mirror job to validate SNAT mapping before rollout. :thumbsup:
jamie: noted, will watch overnight and DM oncall if anything spikes.
deploy-bot: [alert] automated retry of failed bootpacks started at 2025-11-02T04:10:02Z
